handoff.objective: Attack the source-TT compiler protocol before implementation.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether prior work already covers the same mechanism, whether hidden B^5 work or rank and cost laundering can survive, and whether the controls and mutations are sufficient for the claimed boundary.
constraints: Deduplicate by mathematical operation, not by experiment name.
Treat toy correctness, final rank, and source-span membership as insufficient.
Preserve the Fermat-locator and ECDLP claim firewall.
completion_gate: The producer cannot borrow a prior tuple table or verifier oracle.
Rank-minimality and semantic correctness are checked independently.
Every interpretation overreach has an explicit invalidation rule.
handoff.return_format: Use the repository handoff headings and end with one next concrete action.
